segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the order form we discussed: 42 seats on the team plan, annual term, starting March 1. I just wanted to confirm the start date and billing contact before I send it through deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, 42 is right. We may add three more in Q2, but for now keep it at 42. Billing should go to ap@northlineparts.com, and copy me, please.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The net price is $31,920 for the year after the standard 10% volume discount. Payment terms are net 30, and the first invoice would generate on March 1 in the billing tool.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Can you make sure the invoice references PO 44718? Our finance team kicks it back if the PO is missing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I’ll add PO 44718 to the order form and the invoice notes. On implementation, you had asked for go-live by March 18. Our services team has an onboarding slot the week of March 4, so that still works.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We need the admin training before the 12th, though, because our ops lead is out the following week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I can put admin training on March 8 at 10 a.m. Central, 90 minutes. Then end-user training on March 14, if that’s okay.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: March 14 is fine. One contract question: the auto-renewal is 12 months, right? We need 60 days notice to cancel, not 90.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so our standard is 12-month renewal with 60 days notice. I’ll make sure that language is reflected in the terms before signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the order form today if you can. Legal already reviewed the template, so I think we can turn it around by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it by 2 p.m. Eastern with the PO, billing email, 42 seats, and the March dates included. If anything changes on the extra seats, we can handle that with a simple add-on later.
